architecture_override.authority: Explicit live user authorization on 2026-09-02: ADR-0012 is authoritative for Logical Tunnel lifecycle/multipath; ADR-0011 controls per-lane same-association Reality-like bootstrap/no-HOL. ADR-0013/0014/0015 are withdrawn where they globalize the per-lane invariant.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Game/weak-network policy may maintain 2..4 lanes. A -> A+B -> B is REQUIRED for planned healthy make-before-break replacement. Any global one-flow reinterpretation, ordinary Reality TCP followed by a separate FakeTCP payload flow, sustained ordinary TCP HOL, Game disablement, max-lanes=1 rollback, or break-before-make healthy replacement is an ARCHITECTURE REGRESSION. Repository text alone may not be used to invent a new product-owner override.
architecture_override.adr0014: ADR-0014 is withdrawn / invalidated and is not current product authority.
architecture_override.adr0015: ADR-0015 is withdrawn after a later explicit live human correction restored ADR-0012 multipath authority.
architecture_override.human_authority_rule: A product-owner architecture override requires explicit live user authorization; stale repository text or an earlier handoff cannot create one.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: Each lane starts with one FakeTCP-owned public SYN lineage. A bounded reliable ordered adapter on that SAME association carries real TLS 1.3 Reality-like recognition/admission and authenticated Logical Tunnel configuration.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Each lane crosses an explicit in-band barrier into pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3/LINK/datagram payload with no FIN, RST, reconnect or new WBD payload SYN inside that lane.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered semantics are bootstrap-only per lane. After the barrier independently complete datagrams may progress despite an earlier missing FakeTCP range; no cross-lane HOL and no ordinary TCP-over-TCP HOL.
architecture_override.multipath: Normal desired lanes=1; Game desired lanes=2..4; maximum active product lanes=4. Lanes have independent FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK/FEC state and share Logical Tunnel identity/lease plus one logical SessionID/PacketID race namespace. First arrival wins and duplicates are suppressed.
architecture_override.replacement: Use one generation-fenced replacement lifecycle. Candidate failure preserves the healthy old lane. Game rotation replaces one lane at a time.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: Existing mature TCP-like/FakeTCP ACK/SACK/RTO/recovery and release FEC wire behavior is frozen unless deterministic lower-layer evidence isolates a real defect.
